description: Use when the user asks to improve, critique, enhance, rewrite or write a prompt (for you, another chatbot, a coding agent, or an image or video tool), asks what a prompt is missing, or starts a message with "prompt-engine:". Call it first. Returns the Prompt Engine method brief: how to find what the rough prompt leaves out, ask multiple-choice questions with recommended answers (through ask_user), and write and present the enhanced prompt in a fixed format with a score. Pass mode (quick = no questions, standard, deep = extra rounds) and target (the tool or model the prompt is for) when known. It doesn't need the user's prompt text.

mode.description: quick = no questions (recommended defaults become assumptions); standard = one round of up to 8 questions; deep = extra rounds.

target.description: Where the prompt will run, for example "Claude Code", "ChatGPT" or "Midjourney". Leave out to infer it.

name: enhance_prompt
title: Get the Prompt Engine method
